name: CEWF World Championship
epitaph: Held by Lightcrest as of the fed's own first surviving retrospective column (October 1994); no title-change document survives.

name: CEWF Television Championship
epitaph: Won by "Flashy" Freddy Massey out of the fed's first Battle Royal and held through many defenses before Al Andrewson finally beat him for it after a month-long chase.

name: CEWF United States Championship
epitaph: Won by Roger DeCarnac from original holder The Gravedigger, then put up (and lost) in a World Title shot against Lightcrest, which DeCarnac was working to regain as of October 1994.

name: CEWF Battle Royal Championship
epitaph: Won by "Deadly" Dirk Venom during the fed's own European Tour angle, one of at least two Battle Royals he won outright.
